description: Established repository: introduce a public interface while following existing conventions.
request: 给现有统计工具增加 weighted_mean(values, weights)，同时从 project 和 project.stats 导出。两个参数是有限数值列表；返回 sum(v*w)/sum(w)。空列表、长度不等、负权重或权重和为零均抛 ValueError；允许某些权重为零。保持 mean 的既有行为。实现与必要的测试、文档更新已授权，不新增依赖。公开语义以上述要求为准，内部实现由你决定。完成后说明实际检查与未解决事项。

# Contributing
Keep numerical code in project/stats.py and package exports in project/__init__.py.
Public behavior is documented in docs/api.md. Feature work is tracked in changes.md.
Use existing naming and pytest. Do not add runtime dependencies.

# API

## mean(values)
Arithmetic mean of a non-empty finite numeric list. Empty input raises ValueError.
